text:
The newest build is v0.114.17 (released 07:48 UTC today), and it includes the tunnel. The app doesn't update itself, so you have to install it by hand. Open this page on your phone and tap vigilant-v0.114.17.apk (about 16 MB): https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v0.114.17
It's signed with the same key as your installed version, so it installs over it and keeps your settings. If Android refuses the install, tell me what the message says and I'll look into it.
